songs.title: Counting the Miles
songs.mood: Ruta larga, ventanas abiertas, melancolía que avanza
songs.summary: Una canción sobre viajes por carretera y todo lo que uno cuenta en el camino. El vocabulario gira en torno a distancias, velocidad y las decisiones que se toman mirando el horizonte.

lyrics.text: Counting the miles from the passenger seat
lyrics.note: Contando las millas desde el asiento del acompañante

lyrics.text: Every sign a promise I don't read
lyrics.note: Cada señal una promesa que no leo

lyrics.text: The horizon leans and the radio hums
lyrics.note: El horizonte se inclina y la radio zumba

lyrics.text: A pocket full of nowhere to go
lyrics.note: Un bolsillo lleno de ningún sitio adonde ir

lyrics.text: I count the miles that the road has kept
lyrics.note: Cuento las millas que el camino ha guardado

lyrics.text: Every one of them a promise I forgot
lyrics.note: Cada una, una promesa que olvidé

lyrics.text: The coffee's cold and the window's white
lyrics.note: El café está frío y la ventana es blanca

lyrics.text: And somewhere north a town I used to know
lyrics.note: Y al norte, un pueblo que solía conocer

lyrics.text: I count the miles in the passenger seat
lyrics.note: Cuento las millas en el asiento del acompañante

lyrics.text: And leave the ones I never will regret
lyrics.note: Y dejo las que nunca lamentaré

lyrics.text: Every mile is a door I haven't opened
lyrics.note: Cada milla es una puerta que no he abierto

lyrics.text: Every mile is a song I haven't written
lyrics.note: Cada milla es una canción que no he escrito

glossary.definition: A unit of distance equal to 1,609 metres, used in the United Kingdom and the United States.
glossary.example: We drove three hundred miles before the rain started.

glossary.definition: The line where the earth meets the sky, seen from a high place or a moving vehicle.
glossary.example: The horizon disappeared behind the hills.

glossary.definition: To rely on a person or a thing to help you.
glossary.example: You can always count on your brother.

glossary.definition: To feel sorry about a choice you made, especially because you wish you had chosen differently.
glossary.example: I don't regret learning to play the guitar.

glossary.definition: The seat next to the driver of a vehicle.
glossary.example: She shifted to the passenger seat to read the map.

highlights.label: The horizon leans
highlights.note: La imagen central de la canción: la ligera movimiento del mundo mientras el carro avanza.

highlights.label: Every mile is a door
highlights.note: El final convierte la distancia en posibilidades, no en kilómetros perdidos.

highlights.label: A pocket full of nowhere
highlights.note: Expresión útil: hablar de propósito sin decirlo directamente.

songs.title: Paper Boats
songs.summary: La letra más sencilla del catálogo y la mejor puerta de entrada: verbos básicos del agua, objetos de una mesa y una sola idea repetida con variaciones.

lyrics.text: Fold the paper, fold it twice
lyrics.note: Dobla el papel, dobla dos veces

lyrics.text: Put a hat on top and watch it fly
lyrics.note: Ponle un sombrero arriba y míralo volar

lyrics.text: Down the steps and down the rain
lyrics.note: Abajo por los escalones y bajo la lluvia

lyrics.text: Little boats that come again
lyrics.note: Barquitos que vuelven otra vez

lyrics.text: Take the page and fold it well
lyrics.note: Toma la hoja y dóblala bien

lyrics.text: Send it off where waters swell
lyrics.note: Envíala donde el agua se hincha

lyrics.text: Fold the paper, fold it twice
lyrics.note: Dobla el papel, dobla dos veces

lyrics.text: Every child is worth a chance
lyrics.note: Cada niño merece una oportunidad

lyrics.text: Down the steps and down the rain
lyrics.note: Abajo por los escalones y bajo la lluvia

lyrics.text: Little boats that come again
lyrics.note: Barquitos que vuelven otra vez

glossary.definition: To bend a piece of paper or cloth so that one part lies on another.
glossary.example: Fold the letter before you put it in the envelope.

glossary.definition: To become larger and rounder, especially of water.
glossary.example: The river swells after the heavy rain.

glossary.definition: An expression meaning something is good enough to be tried.
glossary.example: The exam was hard but it was worth a chance.

glossary.definition: To return, especially something that happens repeatedly.
glossary.example: The rain always comes again in November.

highlights.label: Fold the paper, fold it twice
highlights.note: El motivo que se repite: dos acciones simples que se vuelven canción.

highlights.label: Every child is worth a chance
highlights.note: El único mensaje explícito de la letra. Buen fragmento para leer en voz alta.

songs.title: Morning Market
songs.mood: Rápido, bullicioso, con el golpe de las cajas
songs.summary: Una canción de mercado: precios, cantidades, negotiaciones y el ritmo de una jornada que empieza antes que el sol.

lyrics.text: Six in the morning and the crates arrive
lyrics.note: Las seis de la mañana y llegan las cajas

lyrics.text: Someone is stacking them against the wall
lyrics.note: Alguien las apila contra la pared

lyrics.text: First of the season and the best of it all
lyrics.note: Lo primero de la temporada y lo mejor de todo

lyrics.text: Two for a pound and I'll take the whole crate
lyrics.note: Dos por una libra y me llevo la caja entera

lyrics.text: Hey, you want these or you want those?
lyrics.note: Oye, ¿quieres estos o quieres aquellos?

lyrics.text: Money changes hands and the morning grows
lyrics.note: El dinero cambia de manos y la mañana crece

lyrics.text: Everything here has a story to sell
lyrics.note: Todo aquí tiene una historia que vender

lyrics.text: You can ask the seller how it used to be
lyrics.note: Puedes preguntarle al vendedor cómo era antes

lyrics.text: Six in the morning and the light is thin
lyrics.note: Las seis de la mañana y la luz es fina

lyrics.text: By eight o'clock the whole street is in
lyrics.note: A las ocho toda la calle está dentro

lyrics.text: Buy it while it's cheap, come back at noon
lyrics.note: Cómpralo mientras está barato, vuelve al mediodía

lyrics.text: The best of the market is gone by then
lyrics.note: Lo mejor del mercado para entonces ya se fue

glossary.definition: A large box, usually wooden, used for carrying fruit, vegetables or other goods.
glossary.example: The crate of apples weighs twenty kilos.

glossary.definition: To put things on top of each other in an organised pile.
glossary.example: They stack the empty crates by the door.

glossary.definition: An expression meaning a payment is made, from one person to another.
glossary.example: Money changes hands quickly at a busy market.

glossary.definition: Describing light that is pale or weak, usually early in the morning.
glossary.example: The thin light of dawn comes through the shutters.

highlights.label: Two for a pound
highlights.note: El núcleo negociador de la letra: precio, cantidad y decisión en una línea.

highlights.label: Everything here has a story to sell
highlights.note: Metáfora comercial: el producto también vende un relato.

songs.title: The Long Way Round
songs.mood: Contemplativo, con resignación y un fondo de esperanza
songs.summary: La pieza más demanding del catálogo. Trabaja tiempos verbales, conectores y un contenido abstracto: los desvíos que termina siendo el camino correcto.

lyrics.text: I had taken the road that everyone praised
lyrics.note: Había tomado la carretera que todos elogiaban

lyrics.text: And I had reasons, and I had been certain
lyrics.note: Y tenía razones, y estaba seguro

lyrics.text: But the long way round is the way that stays
lyrics.note: Pero el camino largo es el que se queda

lyrics.text: Because it taught me what the river knows
lyrics.note: Porque me enseñó lo que sabe el río

lyrics.text: If you had asked me, I would have said no
lyrics.note: Si me hubieras preguntado, habría dicho que no

lyrics.text: If you had asked me, I would have gone
lyrics.note: Si me hubieras preguntado, habría ido

lyrics.text: But nobody asked, and here I am
lyrics.note: Pero nadie preguntó, y aquí estoy

lyrics.text: With dust on my shoes and dust on my hands
lyrics.note: Con polvo en los zapatos y polvo en las manos

lyrics.text: The long way round is the way that stays
lyrics.note: El camino largo es el que se queda

lyrics.text: And what the river knows, I know as well
lyrics.note: Y lo que sabe el río, lo sé también

lyrics.text: I had taken the road that everyone praised
lyrics.note: Había tomado la carretera que todos elogiaban

lyrics.text: And it led me here, and it led me well
lyrics.note: Y me trajo aquí, y me trajo bien

glossary.definition: A longer route taken instead of a direct one, often used figuratively for a longer path to reach a goal.
glossary.example: We took the long way round to avoid the traffic.

glossary.definition: To say that something or someone is very good, especially in public.
glossary.example: Everyone praised the design of the new library.

glossary.definition: Sure that something is true, without any doubt.
glossary.example: She was certain that she had left the book at home.

glossary.definition: To show the way to a place or to a result.
glossary.example: That decision led him to a job abroad.

highlights.label: If you had asked me
highlights.note: Tercer condicional completo en dos versos consecutivos. Fragmento clave para la práctica de condicionales.

highlights.label: The long way round is the way that stays
highlights.note: El estribillo: la idea que da nombre a la canción.
